blocks.text: MANILA, PHILIPPINES – Education Secretary Sonny Angara welcomed the approval by a House of Representatives panel of P1.952 billion in budget additions for the Department of Education (DepEd) under the proposed Fiscal Year 2027 national budget. The Budget Amendments Review Subcommittee (BARSc) of the House Committee on Appropriations, chaired by Nueva Ecija 1st District Rep. Mikaela Suansing, approved the funding boost to restore vital support to priority programs that were unfunded or reduced under the P975.96 billion allocated to DepEd in the 2027 National Expenditure Program (NEP).
